chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abdullah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Link (You should) maintain ties (of kinship), and be affectionate, and show mercy, and be sympathetic.'

key_terms.تَرَاحَمُوا: Show mercy / Be compassionate to one another
key_terms.تَوَاصَلُوا: Maintain ties / Link with each other

ai.seo_question: What are the key ethical behaviors recommended for maintaining social bonds in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) outlines the four pillars of communal solidarity: maintaining contact (*tawasul*), showing respect (*tabarr*), mercy (*tarahhum*), and empathy (*ta'afuf*). This hadith serves as a foundational ethical guideline in Shia jurisprudence for strengthening the social fabric, emphasizing that spiritual unity is manifested through active, reciprocal emotional and physical engagement among believers.
